translations.web: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before Yahweh.
translations.bsb: because on this day atonement will be made for you to cleanse you, and you will be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
translations.kjv: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
translations.asv: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you; from all your sins shall ye be clean before Jehovah.
